segments.speaker: Maya (Rep)
segments.text: Yeah, so thanks for making time, Jordan. I saw your current term runs through September 30, and you were looking at adding the service team before the October go-live, right?

segments.speaker: Jordan (Customer)
segments.text: That's right. We have 38 active users today, and we'd add 12 more. I'd like the new seats active by September 16 so they can train before launch.

segments.speaker: Maya (Rep)
segments.text: Okay, 50 seats total, effective September 16. The annual price on the standard plan would be $42,000, and with the 12 additional seats prorated for the remainder of the term, the invoice for this year comes to $3,150.

segments.speaker: Jordan (Customer)
segments.text: That lines up. Can you keep the renewal date at September 30 next year? Finance doesn't want a second date floating around.

segments.speaker: Maya (Rep)
segments.text: Yep, co-termed to September 30, 2027. One order form, same billing contact, net 30 terms. No change to the data processing addendum.

segments.speaker: Jordan (Customer)
segments.text: Good. On invoicing, please use the PO number I sent this morning, PO-4817. And can the invoice break out the prorated seats separately?

segments.speaker: Maya (Rep)
segments.text: Yes, I have PO-4817, and the billing tool will show the prorated seat line separately from the renewal line. You should see the invoice within one business day after signature.

segments.speaker: Jordan (Customer)
segments.text: Perfect. What about training? We need two admin sessions and one end-user session, all remote.

segments.speaker: Maya (Rep)
segments.text: Included. I put two admin sessions the week of September 9 and one user session the week of September 16 on the order form. Our services coordinator will send calendar options after the order is countersigned.

segments.speaker: Jordan (Customer)
segments.text: Okay. Send it over to me and Priya in procurement. If it matches what we discussed, I can sign by Friday.

segments.speaker: Maya (Rep)
segments.text: Will do. You'll get the order form this afternoon for 50 seats, $42,000 annual renewal, $3,150 prorated addition, co-termed through September 30, 2027, net 30, PO-4817.

segments.speaker: Jordan (Customer)
segments.text: Great, thanks. That should be straightforward.
